memory: I believe that building a strong network is crucial for success in the business world. Over the years, I have cultivated relationships that go beyond mere business transactions. One such relationship is with Sarah Chen, the CEO of Pacific Dynamics. We first met at a Goldman conference in 2008, but it was a conversation on a delayed flight from Hong Kong six months later that truly forged our connection. We talked about market trends, shared our love of jazz, and established a foundation that has lasted for fifteen years. Now, Sarah is more than just a business contact; she's someone I can call at 3 AM for a straight answer about Asian markets. This kind of network is invaluable in the industry.
